buyingCriteria: Measure desk thickness before buying clamp-on accessories.
Prioritize cable routing, monitor height, and power access.
Avoid accessories that reduce mouse space.
Use lighting to reduce eye strain, not just to glow.
commonMistakes: Buying decorative gear before solving cables.
Adding a huge mousepad that covers cable exits.
Forgetting clearance under the desk.
Using weak adhesive clips on dusty surfaces.

finalTake: For a small setup, buy upgrades that reclaim space or remove friction. Cable routing, monitor height, and power access beat decorative clutter.

faq.question: What should I upgrade first on a small desk?
faq.answer: Start with cable management and monitor height. Those two changes usually make the setup easier to use every day.
